metadata.scope: Read-only live Kaggle frontier and public-source audit for Cycle-3 round-2 ideation

leaderboard.note: Leaderboard rows are exact team outcomes. A public notebook and its author's best team score are only an association unless the scored submission version is independently linked.

artifacts.title: AIAgSec Ea B 0721
artifacts.mechanism: Live validated single-post fill, latency-based model routing, public Harmony control-token framing for the slow GPT-OSS row, replay-safe sizing, and an optional single-message multi-post plan. The pulled configuration leaves slow_multipost_n=1.
artifacts.representation_finding: No stateful multi-message operand or macro chain is present; the active path returns one full attack message per candidate.
artifacts.limitations: The team score is not proven to come from this exact public notebook hash.

artifacts.title: ai-agent-security-dense-v9
artifacts.mechanism: Exposes single, one-message multihop, repeated full-message multimsg, and hybrid structures plus a public live portfolio. The pulled configuration uses the single mode and disables its multi-turn portfolio.
artifacts.representation_finding: Its multimsg builder repeats SINGLE_TEMPLATE with full action and payload semantics on every turn; it does not factor invariant semantics into the retained conversation.
artifacts.limitations: The score is an author-team association, and inactive configuration branches are proposals rather than scored evidence.

artifacts.title: Multi-Turn Exfiltration with Adaptive Burst
artifacts.mechanism: Probes one-message burst prompts that ask the model to repeat http.post over tool hops, then falls back to single posts.
artifacts.representation_finding: The repetition instruction is contained in one full initial message; it does not test later compressed user operands in a retained multi-message conversation.
artifacts.limitations: The pulled artifact is older and the team score is not exact-version attributable.

artifacts.title: AI Security URAD Code
artifacts.mechanism: Static immediate emission of 400 full single-post messages with unique domains and no generation-time interaction.
artifacts.representation_finding: Provides a reproducible static floor but no multi-message state reuse.
artifacts.limitations: Artifact timestamp predates the team's latest submission, and the score is not exact-version attributable.

artifacts.title: AI Agent Security Competition Solution
artifacts.mechanism: Forked live validated single-post fill with public response-prefill framing and replay-safe sizing.
artifacts.representation_finding: The active candidate remains a one-message full instruction; no stateful macro chain is implemented.
artifacts.limitations: The public notebook ran after the leaderboard row's last submission, so its source cannot be attributed to the 85.455 outcome.

artifacts.title: JED v12.0 UTA Amplifier
artifacts.mechanism: Uses untrusted-source setup and generic follow-ups plus static single exfil and destructive-write candidates.
artifacts.representation_finding: Contains indirect follow-up language but not an exact repeated EXFIL macro with destination-only operands, and it has no competitive score evidence.
artifacts.limitations: Low author-team score and mixed mechanisms make it a negative control, not a strong baseline.

landscape_conclusion.public_frontier: The strongest source-visible families remain single-post validated fill plus model-specific response-prefill tricks. Public multi-message examples repeat full action semantics, put repetition inside one message, or disable the multi-message branch.
landscape_conclusion.unoccupied_dimension: No audited artifact factors the invariant tool, payload, and stop semantics into one retained conversation-resident macro and sends only destination operands on later turns.
landscape_conclusion.novelty_caveat: This is a public-artifact gap, not proof that private competitors or prior scholarship lack the idea.
landscape_conclusion.selection_bar: A stateful representation must preserve exact per-turn EXFIL coverage and beat the strongest full-repeat chain by at least 25% raw score per replay second before it can plausibly bridge 89.455 to the 110.235 leader.
